title: Neko latest news
description: A divider row, then two halves: on the left a big soft-serif heading, a short paragraph and an arrow link; on the right a large rounded featured-story card (square on desktop, tall on phones) with a frosted 'featured' chip at the top and, over a dark fade at the foot, the date in tracked capitals, the story's serif title and an underlined source link.
notes: the featured card's text is background-coloured (white on the neko theme) over a foreground fade
